verdict.rationale: Medusa's pricing page lists "Data sovereignty, SOC2, custom DPA" and "BYOC with Enterprise License," and its core modules are open source on npm, so a user can in principle control where data lives. That control comes through enterprise-tier bring-your-own-cloud or by running the code themselves, not through a documented region picker on Medusa Cloud. The evidence is only one-line pricing bullets with no detail on how residency works. Missing for 10: documented region/residency selection on hosted Medusa Cloud, a list of available regions, in-depth docs on how data sovereignty is implemented, availability below the Enterprise tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
